about.title: About FIDP Map
about.description1: The data displayed here comes directly from the {link} website. It remains their exclusive property.
about.description2: I collected this information through scraping their website and conducting my own research. This data was then compiled to design this map, providing a better overview of the foundation's properties throughout the canton of Geneva.
about.howItWorksDesc: This application visualizes real estate assets geographically using modern web technologies. You can search, filter by foundation or location, and view detailed information for each building.
about.opensourceDesc: This project is open-source and dedicated to the community. Transparency and accessibility are at the heart of its design.
